# Summer Reading Program 2026: Final Report


## Summary

The 2026 Summer Reading Program ran for eight weeks, from June 1 to July 24. Registration was open to
children and teens at all three Eastgate branches. By the end of week 8, 572 readers had registered: 410
children and 162 teens.

Summer Reading registrations by week


Figure 1. Cumulative Summer Reading registrations by program week, children and teens.

![Registered readers (cumulative) Children (ages 0-12) 410 400 Teens (ages 13-17) 300 200 162 100 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 Program week](figures/1.1)


## Highlights

. Sign-ups were strongest in the second week, when 96 new readers joined.

. Weekly sign-ups fell after week 4 as the program reached most of its audience.

. Children made up 72 percent of registrations and teens 28 percent.

## Community Notice


### SUMMER READING FINALE

Saturday, July 25 at 11:00 AM
Main Reading Room, Eastgate Public Library
Prizes and certificates for every finisher.

Figure 2. Notice posted at the circulation desk.


## Budget and Next Steps

Funding came from a $6,500 foundation grant and $2,100 in business donations. Spending totaled $7,940,
of which prizes were $4,605 (58 percent), leaving $660 to carry into next year.

Staff recommend opening registration one week earlier in 2027 and adding a family reading track.
